title: Prime Minister extends greetings on RSS Sthapana Divas
subtitle: PM shares motivating address by Dr. Mohan Bhagwat Ji during the Shatabdi Varsh Shri Vijayadashami Utsav
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today extended his greetings to all Swayamsevaks on the special occasion of RSS Sthapana Divas and shared a motivating address by Sarsanghchalak Dr. Mohan Bhagwat Ji delivered during the Shatabdi Varsh Shri Vijayadashami Utsav in Nagpur.
In a series of posts on X, the Prime Minister shared:
"Today, on the special occasion of RSS Sthapana Divas, my greetings to all Swayamsevaks. I also pay homage to all those greats who have nurtured the RSS over the years.
The RSS has completed a remarkable century of service, nation-building and social harmony. Countless Swayamsevaks have worked for society with a deep sense of duty and a nation-first spirit.
May this spirit keep strengthening national development in the times to come.
राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ के स्थापना दिवस के विशेष अवसर पर सभी स्वयंसेवकों को मेरी हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं! मैं उन सभी विभूतियों को भी नमन करता हूं, जिन्होंने अपने अथक परिश्रम और सेवाभाव से संघ को सींचा और संवारा है।
राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ ने सेवा, राष्ट्र निर्माण और सामाजिक प्रतिबद्धता का गौरवशाली शताब्दी वर्ष पूर्ण किया है। अनगिनत स्वयंसेवकों ने अपने समर्पण, कर्तव्य-निष्ठा और राष्ट्र-प्रथम की भावना से सदैव समाज के उत्थान के लिए कार्य किया है।
मुझे विश्वास है कि यह भावना आने वाले समय में भी देश को और सशक्त एवं सुदृढ़ करेगी।"

"A very motivating address by Param Pujya Sarsanghchalak Dr. Mohan Bhagwat Ji during the Shatabdi Varsh Shri Vijayadashami Utsav in Nagpur.
He has spoken at length on a wide range of issues including national progress and social unity, the need for self-reliance and to strengthen the character of society.
Particularly noteworthy was his emphasis on the commitment to Seva and nation building that is integral to every RSS Swayamsevak.
He also spoke about the Panch Parivartan and how these can contribute meaningfully to positive social change.
